page_title: RSO 0-1 RMA | Real Sociedad v Real Madrid 26/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Jose Luis Munuera Montero has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+5' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alex Remiro pulls off an easy save.
90+5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+4' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
90+4' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul. A free kick to Real Sociedad.
90+3' Joselu (Real Madrid) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90+2' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:4.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
89' Here comes a substitution. Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Robin Le Normand.
88' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows the yellow card to Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
87' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
85' The game is interrupted. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
84' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luka Modric.
83' Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows a yellow card to Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.

82' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
82' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends the corner into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga intercepts it and averts the threat.
82' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Real Sociedad win a corner.
81' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
80' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked. The ball goes out of play. Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
78' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but Kepa Arrizabalaga punches the ball away.
76' Substitution. Brahim Diaz walks off the pitch and Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
76' It is time for a substitution. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is on for Fran Garcia.
75' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) replaces Ander Barrenetxea.
75' Alvaro Odriozola comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad).
75' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.

71' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Brahim Diaz was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
70' Today's referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero rightly decides to book Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) for his harsh tackle.

69' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
68' Substitution. Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dani Ceballos walks off.
68' Here is a change. Arda Guler is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
67' Substitution. Benat Turrientes will be replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
64' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
63' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and it's Arda Guler (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
60' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
58' Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
58' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.

56' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
56' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
54' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle as Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
54' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) plays a one-two with Brahim Diaz, but the move breaks down.
52' Real Madrid control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
50' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
49' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Sociedad.
48' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.

48' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
48' The resulting corner, taken by Luka Modric (Real Madrid), comes to nothing.
47' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) works the corner short.

46' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Jose Luis Munuera Montero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
45+2' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The resulting corner from Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
44' Jose Luis Munuera Montero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) and blew his whistle.
43' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is flagged for offside.
42' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
41' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
40' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
39' The linesman signals that Joselu (Real Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
39' A snap shot by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro produces a good save to thwart him.
35' Celebrations are cut short for Real Sociedad as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
33' The Real Sociedad players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

33' The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Kepa Arrizabalaga, so the score changes to 1:1.
32' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

31' A snap shot by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga produces a good save to thwart him. The referee blows his whistle, Real Sociedad are awarded a corner kick.
30' 0 - 1 Goal! Daniel Carvajal tees up Arda Guler (Real Madrid) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to score low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.

28' What a chance that is! Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
27' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
26' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid earn a free kick.
24' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
21' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
20' The Real Sociedad players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
15' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) was probably a bit loose with his words to Jose Luis Munuera Montero, who decides to show him a yellow.

15' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! It will be a corner kick for Real Sociedad.

12' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
8' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) attempts to find Takefusa Kubo, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
8' Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
6' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle. Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play.
5' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
2' Joselu (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
